label: Ubiquiti UniFi Security Gateway (USG)
description: UniFi Security Gateway: 3x 1G RJ45 data ports (1 WAN + 2 LAN) and a serial console, no PoE, 1 Gbps line rate.
notes: Vendor figures from Ubiquiti's own datasheet: **(3) 10/100/1000 RJ45 ports plus (1) RJ45 serial console**, 3 Gbps forwarding, 1.5 Mpps. **Nothing here is PoE and nothing is modular** - the base USG is a fixed 3-port box. The datasheet also states the port split: one WAN, two LAN, which is why a USG in a topology is always the narrowest link in the chain.
